name: Home First Finance Company India Ltd
title: Home First Finance Company India Ltd - 543259 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Home First Q4FY26: AUM up 24.9% YoY to INR5,878cr with 30+ DPD down 50bps to 3.2% and spread held at 5.3%; guides ~25% AUM growth FY27 and credit cost 30-40bps.

triggers.label: 30+ DPD 3.2%, down 50bps QoQ
triggers.quote: 30+ DPD improved to 3.2%, down by 50 bps sequentially.

triggers.label: FY27 AUM growth ~25% YoY
triggers.quote: we are positioned to deliver around 25% year -on-year AUM growth.

triggers.label: Spread held 5.3%, guided 5-5.25%
triggers.quote: our spread, excluding co-lending, remained healthy at 5.3%.

guidance.quote: we are positioned to deliver around 25% year -on-year AUM growth.
Our aim remains to deliver a spread at a portfolio level in our guided range of 5% to 5.25%.
Guidance on the credit cost is the same. 30bps to 40bps.
we expect this ratio to remain broadly range-bound within 2.6% to 2.7%.
Our branch strategy is to add about 30 to 40 branches every year.

red_flags.label: Co-lending disbursement dip, addressed by May
red_flags.quote: It should get addressed this quarter. Some progress has been made in the first month of April.

red_flags.label: Tamil Nadu/Telangana growth muted
red_flags.quote: the growth was very muted in Tamil Nadu

evasions.quote: Number of branches which are less than INR10 crores would be very small. Maybe 10 odd branches.
So we are not targeting a more premium cus tomer as such.
